name: dsh-quiet-update
description: Silent, startup-time updates for installed DSH plugins: uses the host's official plugin manager, handles exact-pinned registry dependencies, stays completely silent when there is nothing to install, and skips the market, itself, local link installs and GitHub installs. 启动后在后台静默更新已装插件。
author: xinming-chenniang

meta.title: 静默插件更新
meta.description: 启动后在后台静默更新已装第三方插件；没更新时完全不出声。走官方插件管理器，支持精确锁版，跳过市场与本地/GitHub 安装项。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/run.js && node --check lib/tools.js && node --check lib/state.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/pick.js && node --check lib/toast.js && node --check lib/settings.js
